relevance.rationale: Identified from the AGT title block: a deformation-theory result for complete finite-volume hyperbolic 3-manifolds with compact non-empty GEODESIC BOUNDARY and k toric cusps, using partially truncated triangulations; it shows the solution variety of the consistency equations is a smooth manifold of real dimension 2k near the complete structure, and that small deformations move the compact tetrahedra and the boundary structure only at second order. The corpus's hyperbolic machinery is entirely the CUSPED ideal-triangulation setting (Neumann-Zagier gluing equations, det J_NZ, angle structures, spun-normal surfaces for m004/L5a1/L6a4). A grep for 'geodesic boundary' across content/, docs/ and computations/ returns zero hits -- there is no truncated-tetrahedron or geodesic-boundary object anywhere in the tree for this smoothness statement to attach to. Scope-(a): as read, nothing usable here; the truncated-triangulation technique is not thereby excluded, it simply has no consumer today.

proposedActions.rationale: The corpus's deformation-space work lives on cusped ideal triangulations (the NZ Jacobian used by the 1-loop torsion cusp law); the geodesic-boundary analogue has no consumer.
